description: Opt-in, on top of the default preset. It is kept out of the default because a preset's packageRules win over a repository's top-level automerge: false, so a repository that keeps every merge to a person could not turn it off

packageRules.description: Patch, digest and pinning updates are merged by Renovate itself once the pull request's checks pass; minor and major updates only open a pull request. This relies on platformAutomerge being off, as the default preset sets it: Renovate merges only once it sees the checks green, and a branch with no checks at all is never green to it, so it is never merged. A repository using this should run its checks on every pull request, without a paths filter that would leave Renovate's branches untested
